summary: Join our Data Analytics for Government and Public Sector Course. Equip yourself with essential skills to analyze data and drive effective public policies.
lede: Government analytics training covers how public-sector data, policy, and performance professionals can turn service and administrative records into evidence for decisions. You’ll practise framing decision problems, checking data quality, analysing service trends, and creating Power BI dashboards and clear recommendations, with an introduction to privacy-aware data governance.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who work with public-sector data, performance information, policy evidence, or service-delivery reporting. It is designed for foundation to intermediate learners who need a practical analytical workflow rather than advanced programming or production machine-learning engineering.
prerequisites: You should have basic experience working with spreadsheets, reports, operational records, or programme information. No programming or statistical degree is required, and the practical labs focus on guided spreadsheet and Power BI workflows rather than Python development or production machine-learning deployment. Bring a laptop if you want to reproduce the exercises after training.
